name: Seibu Holdings Inc.
summary: Seibu Holdings Inc. engages in the urban transportation, hotel and leisure, real estate, construction, and baseball team management businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Urban Transportation and Railway Business, Hotel and Leisure Business, Real Estate Business, and Others segments. The company offers railway, bus, and taxi transportation services; and operates hotels, hot springs and spas, golf club and courses, ski resorts, tennis courts, bowling alleys, skating rinks, fitness clubs, and other leisure facilities.
